step.carRegistration.title: Tell us about your car
registration.label: Car registration
registration.hint: For example, AB12 CDE. You can find it on your car’s number plate or V5C logbook.
registration.error.pattern: Car registration must only include letters a to z, numbers and spaces, and be 8 characters or fewer
annualMileage.label: How many miles do you expect to drive in a year?
annualMileage.hint: Include personal and work journeys. An estimate is fine.
annualMileage.error.required: Enter how many miles you expect to drive in a year
annualMileage.error.invalidNumber: Annual mileage must be a whole number, like 8000
annualMileage.error.min: Annual mileage must be 1 mile or more
annualMileage.error.max: Annual mileage must be 100,000 miles or fewer
modified.label: Has the car been modified?
modified.hint: For example, changes to the engine, suspension, wheels or bodywork that did not come from the manufacturer.
modified.error.required: Select yes if the car has been modified
imported.label: Was the car imported?
imported.error.required: Select yes if the car was imported
coverStart.label: When do you want your cover to start?
coverStart.hint: This must be within the next 30 days. For example, 27 10 2026.
coverStart.error.required: Enter the date you want your cover to start
coverStart.error.notPast: Cover start date must be today or in the future
coverStart.error.maxDaysAhead: Cover start date must be within the next {days} days
step.carUsage.title: Owning and using the car
purchased.label: Have you bought the car yet?
purchased.error.required: Select yes if you have bought the car
purchaseDate.label: When did you buy the car?
purchaseDate.hint: For example, 14 3 2024. If you are not sure of the day, enter the 1st of the month.
purchaseDate.error.required: Enter the date you bought the car
purchaseDate.error.notFuture: The date you bought the car must be today or in the past
legalOwner.label: Who is the legal owner of the car?
legalOwner.hint: The legal owner is the person or company who paid for the car. This can be different from the registered keeper.
legalOwner.error.required: Select who the legal owner of the car is
usage.label: What will you use the car for?
usage.option.sdp.hint: Personal journeys like shopping, visiting friends and holidays, but not commuting.
usage.option.commuting.hint: Personal journeys and driving to and from a regular place of work or study.
usage.option.business.hint: Driving to different places as part of your job, like visiting clients.
usage.error.required: Select what you will use the car for
keptAtHome.label: Will the car be kept at your home address overnight?
keptAtHome.error.required: Select yes if the car will be kept at your home address overnight
overnightPostcode.label: What is the postcode where the car is kept overnight?
overnightPostcode.error.required: Enter the postcode where the car is kept overnight
overnightPostcode.error.postcode: Enter a real postcode, like LS1 4AP
overnightLocation.label: Where is the car parked overnight?
overnightLocation.error.required: Select where the car is parked overnight

firstName.label: First name
firstName.error.maxLength: First name must be 50 characters or fewer
lastName.label: Last name
lastName.error.maxLength: Last name must be 50 characters or fewer
dateOfBirth.label: What is your date of birth?
dateOfBirth.error.notFuture: Date of birth must be in the past
dateOfBirth.error.minYearsAgo: You must be {years} or older to get a car insurance quote
